questions.stem: On Modular scale: a designer reviewing a museum exhibition poster notices that heading sizes are chosen arbitrarily and feel unrelated. What does a modular scale provide to solve this?

questions.learningObjective: evaluate visual dominance in a design critique
questions.stem: On Visual dominance: a designer reviewing a museum exhibition poster notices that every element on a poster competes for equal attention. What is missing from this composition?

options.text: More elements added to fill the remaining empty space
options.misconception: mistakes added density for a clear hierarchy

options.text: Identical styling applied to absolutely every element
options.misconception: reinforces the competition instead of resolving it

options.text: A dominant element that establishes a clear first read
A wider range of colors assigned to every single item
options.misconception: confuses mere variety with a dominant focal point

questions.explanation: Dominance means one element is clearly the most important and wins the first glance. When everything is equal the eye has no entry point, so scaling or emphasizing one element gives the composition a focal point and a clear reading order.
questions.hint: Where should the viewer look first when seeing this design?

questions.stem: On Visual dominance: a designer reviewing a nonprofit annual report notices that every element on a poster competes for equal attention. What is missing from this composition?

options.text: More elements added to fill the remaining empty space
options.misconception: mistakes added density for a clear hierarchy

options.text: A dominant element that establishes a clear first read
Identical styling applied to absolutely every element
options.misconception: reinforces the competition instead of resolving it

options.text: A wider range of colors assigned to every single item
options.misconception: confuses mere variety with a dominant focal point

questions.explanation: Dominance means one element is clearly the most important and wins the first glance. When everything is equal the eye has no entry point, so scaling or emphasizing one element gives the composition a focal point and a clear reading order.
questions.hint: Where should the viewer look first when seeing this design?
